items.title: Slide Hampton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And there was Purvis Henson, tenor saxophone player.

ctx.x: No. It hasn’t gotten any due.
Within that band, besides Harold Minerve and Gil Askey, what other jazz players were there?

There was a trombone player that was playing lead. He was a Muslim, I remember. I can’t remember his name, but he played. He really played. He was a jazz player. And there was Purvis Henson, tenor saxophone player.
